clips.text: Your turn. Give this box anything wordy, and it comes back as a pixel reel, read out by me.
It can be a link to an article. A letter you've been sent. Or just a question, like, how does a mortgage work.
Type it, or paste it in. Drop a file anywhere on this page. Or, on a phone, take a photo of the letter.
Then press Make my reel. Claude writes the scenes, I read them out, and it plays as soon as it is ready.
Still too much to take in? Ask for it simpler, or shorter. And your reels are listed here, to watch again, or to delete.
